# Repository agent guidance

<!-- PROJECT-WIKI:BEGIN -->
Before modifying source or docs, read `.project-wiki/INDEX.md`, `.project-wiki/STATUS.md`, and task-relevant wiki records. Use the project-wiki skill for scans, updates, sync and maintenance. Keep verified implementation in `technical/`, explicit stakeholder intent in `requirements/`, decisions/uncertainty in open questions or change records, and update traceability, status, registry and weekly audit log for meaningful edits. Preserve original evidence, IDs and provenance; write wiki contents in English.
